**Incident postmortem: the expired TLS certificate**

On February 3, our TLS certificate expired. For 47 minutes, from 09:12 to 09:59 UTC, 18% of requests failed.

The certificate passed its expiration date and nothing warned us, because we had no expiry alert. We only found out when users ran into errors.

Service was fully restored by 09:59. The incident also showed us where our monitoring was missing.

Our top priority now is adding certificate expiry monitoring and alerts, so renewals are routine instead of a surprise.
